transcript.text: My child argues when screen time ends. What small step can I try?

requests.reviewNotes: Coach; useful different action on follow-up, one check-in, no invented facts. Aim 60–120 English words or similarly brief Urdu; no automatic follow-up promise.

reply.acknowledgment: It is completely normal for children to push back when transitioning away from screens.
steps: Give a gentle heads-up five minutes before screen time ends so they can mentally prepare.
Use a visual timer so they can see the time running down themselves.
Offer an engaging transition activity right after screen time, like a favorite snack or a quick game.
reply.checkIn: Would you like to try one of these steps today?
